bio.title: About me
bio.subtitle: Code, coffee and curiosity.
paragraphs: I'm an independent developer. For the last 6 years I've been turning ideas into production software: web platforms processing millions of events, desktop apps used daily by thousands, and tiny scripts that save people hours.
I care about the craft: clean architecture, honest performance budgets and interfaces that feel instant. Every project I ship is something I'd gladly use myself.
principles: Ship small, ship often — momentum beats perfection
Performance is a feature, not an afterthought
Open source by default — share what you learn
Details are not details — they make the design
